report.name: rf_stream_start2
report.purpose: Second variant of the RF transmit-stream start routine in the LMAC RF firmware image of the AIC8800D80 WiFi SoC. Per its docstring it kicks off the RF stream configuration/calibration sequence used when a transmission chain (PHY/RF TX path) is being prepared. The '2' suffix indicates an alternate entry point or a second instantiation of the stream-start sequence, likely used in a different band/bandwidth/chain context from rf_stream_start. It belongs to the RF transmit (TX) subsystem that programs the on-chip radio before packets are sent.

parameters.name: rf_stream_cfg
parameters.purpose: RF stream configuration word / channel-band-bandwidth selector passed via r0

parameters.name: calib_flags
parameters.purpose: Calibration / path-enable bitmap passed via r1 (inferred)

parameters.name: ctx_ptr
parameters.purpose: Pointer to RF context / shared state block in RAM (inferred from calling convention)

return_value.meaning: 0 on successful stream-start ack, negative error code if RF refused the stream configuration

side_effects: Writes RF front-end control registers (RFIC page, address range 0x40xxxx region typical of AIC8800 RF controller)
Asserts/deasserts RF AGC, LO, and PA enable bits in the radio control MMIO block
Triggers an RF calibration sweep via the RF sequencer MMIO
Posts a status / completion event back to the LMAC TX scheduler (IPC mailbox)
Updates the RF stream state in shared RAM context
report.summary: Alternate RF transmit-stream start / pre-TX calibration entry point in the AIC8800D80 LMAC RF firmware.
